01 What I do

Four disciplines, one job: systems people can trust.

  • A

    DevSecOps

    Security built into delivery: vulnerability scanning in CI/CD, least-privilege IAM, secrets management and threat modeling.

  • B

    Data protection

    Certified DPO work for healthcare platforms: impact assessments (DPIAs), privacy by design, and alignment with HIPAA, GDPR and Nigeria's NDPR.

  • C

    Cloud and platform engineering

    Multi-AZ AWS and Azure architecture, reusable Terraform modules, Kubernetes, and observability with Prometheus and Grafana.

  • D

    Education

    Hands-on training in Linux, Docker, Kubernetes, AWS and CI/CD, plus mentoring for engineers moving into cloud and platform roles.
